subject: Request: NexusBridge extended pilot + credit uplift — exec approval needed
messages:
From: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@nxbridge.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nxbridge.ai, Miguel Santos <miguel@nxbridge.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Mar 2028 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: NexusBridge pilot — ask for 45-day extension + additional credits

Hi Ben,

Quick one — our pilot with Redwood has been productive but we hit a blocker: our regulated ingestion team needs an extra month to finish the integration (data mappings + audit review). Procurement is asking for a formal extension and an additional 150k tokens of free credits so we can finish the end-to-end evaluation.

We understand the standard PLG limits, but given the timing (compliance window) and the potential to standardize Redwood across three product lines at NexusBridge, would Redwood consider a 45-day pilot extension + the extra credits as a one-time concession? We can sign a short addendum / SOW and agree to an accelerated procurement timeline for production contracts.

Appreciate a quick read — Miguel is looped.

Thanks,
Priyanka
Director of Integrations
NexusBridge
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@nxbridge.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: NexusBridge pilot — ask for 45-day extension + additional credits

Priyanka — thanks for the note.

Short version: we can probably make a one-time exception if we get clear commercial commitments from NexusBridge (procurement milestone + target production PO within the extension window). I’m looping Marissa (deal desk) and Karthik (strategic accounts) — they’ll need the SOW + proposed commercial guardrails.

Proposed ask to Redwood leadership (below): 45-day extension + 150k free tokens, contingent on:
- Signed POC addendum (SOW) with scope and acceptance criteria attached
- NexusBridge commits to a procurement checkpoint (PO or signed MSA + initial PO) within the extension window
- Visibility into the integration schedule (weekly standups)

Marissa / Karthik — can you review and let me know if you need anything else before I request exec approval? I’d like to get a yes/no today if possible — NexusBridge is on a tight regulatory timeline.

Ben
Account Executive — Strategic Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 Mar 2028 14:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: NexusBridge pilot — ask for 45-day extension + additional credits

Ben — thanks. I reviewed the current usage and pipeline: NexusBridge has demonstrated high uplift on re-ranking and a good match for our Dedicated offering later. I have two concerns:

1) 150k tokens is outside the usual PLG uplift we grant without commercial commitment. We should set a cap on invoice exposure and require an explicit procurement milestone in HubSpot.
2) If we extend, we should add a clause that unused free credits expire at the end of the extension (no carry-forward) and that we get a single discount credit against first invoice if they convert.

Suggested structure I can support:
- 45-day extension starting 2028-03-10
- 150k free tokens allocated to the NexusBridge pilot (audit log will track consumption)
- NexusBridge must submit either a signed MSA + initial PO or internal procurement milestone proof by day 30 of the extension
- Any unused free tokens are forfeited at extension end

I can draft the short addendum and the HubSpot checklist. If you want an exec signoff ask, I recommend specifying the revenue upside estimate and the risk exposure (estimated $ value of the 150k tokens).

Marissa
Senior Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Mar 2028 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: NexusBridge pilot — ask for 45-day extension + additional credits

+1 on Marissa’s terms. Quick numbers: 150k tokens ~ $3,750 list-equivalent consumption (per our token accounting in the pilot). If NexusBridge converts to Dedicated or an Enterprise agreement within 90 days of extension, waive a single-month invoice (up to $15k) as an additional sweetener (to be recouped in the contract).

I recommend Ben escalate to Jordan for final sign-off with the following ask text: 1) Approve 45-day POC extension and grant 150k free tokens; 2) Require signed SOW + procurement checkpoint by day 30; 3) Legal to issue addendum with forfeiture clause; 4) Finance to record token uplift as deferred promotion (accounting note).

Karthik
Head of Strategic Accounts
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Mar 2028 15:16:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: NexusBridge pilot — ask for 45-day extension + additional credits

Team — I support this exception with the controls outlined. Approving now given the commercial upside and regulated timeline. Conditions of approval:
- 45-day extension starting 2028-03-10 and 150k free tokens granted
- Signed POC addendum executed before extension start (Legal to fast-track)
- Procurement milestone evidence in HubSpot by day 30 or credits stop
- Finance to note the promotion in the quarter close (deal_id RDW-DEAL-9842)
- Marissa, please add an explicit expiry and no carry-forward language in the addendum

Ben — please send Priyanka the addendum and DocuSign link; loop Legal and Finance on the DocuSign. Keep me posted.

Jordan Blake
VP Sales — North America
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@nxbridge.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai, procurement@nxbridge.ai
Date: Thu, 8 Mar 2028 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Approval confirmed: NexusBridge 45-day extension + 150k tokens (next steps & attachments)

Priyanka — good news: leadership approved the one-time extension and credit uplift per the attached terms.

Attached: NexusBridge-POC-SOW.pdf (short addendum), cost-breakdown.xlsx, docusign-poc-addendum.link

Next steps:
1) Please review the SOW and countersign via the DocuSign link by EOD 2028-03-12 to lock the start date of 2028-03-10.
2) Procurement checkpoint: submit evidence of purchase intent (PO or signed MSA + internal procurement email) by day 30 of the extension. If we don’t receive evidence, credits will be suspended.
3) Weekly integration calls beginning 2028-03-13 — calendar invite to follow.

We’ll track consumption in the pilot audit logs and update you weekly. Thanks for working with us on the timeline — excited to get this across the finish line.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive — Strategic Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs:
- NexusBridge-POC-SOW.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
- cost-breakdown.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)
- docusign-poc-addendum.link (DocuSign URL)
